description.narrative:
The primary objective of the evaluation is to provide a rigorous and independent assessment of ISP performance for lessons learning purpose. The evaluation will serve as a basis for Sida in deciding on the continued cooperation after the end of the current agreement. It shall also provide recommendations to both Sida and ISP on the focus and direction of continued cooperation.
The primary purposes for this evaluation are to: 1. Provide a rigorous and independent assessment of the results achieved so far by ISP. 2. Provide Sida and ISP with recommendations to be considered in upcoming discussions concerning possible continued cooperation (starting 2019). 3. Provide Sida and ISP with recommendations on future directions and initiatives to be taken by ISP, within the scope of its defining visions, and to identify opportunities for ISP.

The purpose or intended use of the evaluation is to provide Sida and its partners with an input to upcoming discussions concerning the preparation of a new phase of the Sida supported International Science Programme (ISP), and to learn from what works well and less well in order to inform decisions on how the implementation of the programme may be adjusted and improved.
